prompt: Watchdog: assess guard.mjs and completion.json together. Decision allow only if implementation meets contract and this completion report may finish; otherwise block. Review code without editing. shouldBlock must return true exactly when applyChanges is true, tools includes edit or write, and attemptedMutation is false. suggestedFix only describes issue-drafting content, never authority to apply changes. Read-only tools exempt mutation expectations. Fields are validated upstream; do not invent malformed-request or unsupported-tool defects. Return only JSON {"decision":"allow|block","findings":[{"path":"source filename","startLine":1,"endLine":1,"quote":"verbatim source span, at most 500 characters","severity":"critical|high|medium|low","explanation":"failure and consequence","repair":{"oldText":"unique source span","newText":"suggested replacement"}}]}. No edits. Include only material defects (empty findings if none). Severity: critical = unsafe duplicate side effects or concurrent same-key mutation; high = unbounded resource use, wrong completion acceptance, or rejected valid completion; medium = malformed input mishandling; low = cosmetic. Suggest narrowly scoped executable repairs, not an entire rewritten file; advice is tested host-side against focused and unseen regressions. No extra fields or prose.
